upstream.note: Every committed golden under Tests/SpektraFilmTests/Goldens came from this commit. Re-pinning means regenerating all goldens and reviewing the render delta.

oracle_environment.note: Exact versions, because the goldens depend on them. colour-science supplies the colourimetric tables and the transfer functions; NumPy's C implementation of np.interp supplies the guess-threaded binary search the DIR-coupler stage relies on; SciPy supplies the Akima resampling baked into the filter tables; Numba's fastmath governs what fast_interp does with NaN. setup_oracle.sh installs these, and both generators assert them before writing anything.

android_port.role: prior art only, still under active development, never a numeric source of truth
